messages.author: 4828922e42cc87c0
messages.subject: RRO 8.0.2 and lm function causes crash in RStudio
parts:
Running the latest version of RStudio for Windows.  With latest RRO 8.0.2 lm function crashes RStudio.  lm(mtcars, mpg ~ disp).
No logs gets generated.  Uninstalled, and installed RRO 8.0.1 with latest RStudio - everything is fine.
Thanks

messages.author: 88275a537c4bd7d2
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Re: RRO 8.0.2 and lm function causes crash in RStudio
parts:
Hi Kaveh,

Thanks again for reporting the issue -- in fact most math-related commands cause a crash when running RRO under RStudio on Windows. This problem will be fixed in the upcoming RRO 8.0.3, but for now you can work around the problem by replacing your Rprofile.site file. The details are in the release notes:

https://github.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RRO/releases/tag/v8.0.2-beta

Thanks again,
# David Smith
